notes: American Vanguard Corp (NYSE: AVD) — specialty crop chemistry (CIK 5981). Manufactures + distributes pesticides, fungicides, herbicides for fruit, vegetable, nut, and row crops. Calendar fiscal year. Reports in USD. SmartBox/SIMPAS precision-application platforms. Severe 2023-24 industry destocking + internal control weaknesses → 2024 financial restatement, going-concern issues, transformation program. Sells products globally (US, Mexico, Brazil, EU, Australia).

periods.notes: FY20: revenue $458M. EBITDA $47M. Net income $11M. Steady year for crop chemistry.
FY21: revenue $559M (+22%). EBITDA $54M. Net income $14M. Acquisitions including Agrinos.
FY22: revenue $609M (+9%). EBITDA $65M. Net income $18M. Strong agriculture cycle.
FY23 (restated): revenue $568M (-7%). EBITDA $-8M (channel destocking + writedowns). Net loss $47M. Material weaknesses identified; restated figures.

FY24: revenue $506M (-11%). EBITDA $18M (transformation program ongoing, restructuring charges $30M+). Net loss $56M. Dividend suspended. Going-concern uncertainty addressed via amended credit facility.
